headline: Nothing synced for Thursday - third window missed - and the one clean bike window of the week shuts at 11:00.
body:
The laptop went quiet again, so Thursday is blank rather than empty. training.json is still stamped **30 Sep 21:31**, **34.8 hours** old against an 18-hour threshold, and three push windows have gone by without one. No file and no wellness row, so I have not marked it missed - six times in this file a silent pipeline hid a real session.

Readiness is unreadable for the same reason. Wednesday was HRV **79** on a **68.3** 14-day mean, RHR **44** - green then, two mornings stale now. Hold steady today; do not push on it.

Ride, and go early. A **35 km/h** gust before 11:00 is the only bike-good window left in the forecast; **47** midday and **55** evening are rideable with care. Saturday is gone at **91**. Sixty to seventy-five minutes, **131-150 bpm**, 26-28 km/h on the flat, climbs capped at **155**.

Twelve days since the race with nothing on foot. Recovery, or the ankle?
